safety_lead_time.comparison_action: Decrease safety lead time from 3.2 to 1.18 days

narrative: Material PL2__M84B015C exhibits intermittent demand patterns with 39.4% of working days having non-zero demand. The demand variability (CV=0.59) combined with moderate lead time variability (CV=0.53) requires a safety stock of 3243 units to achieve the target 95% service level. This is 38.6% higher than the current SAP setting of 2339 units. The Economic Order Quantity analysis suggests an order quantity of 8099 units, which respects the MOQ of 187 units and stays within storage capacity. The recommended (r,Q) continuous review policy has a reorder point of 4923 units. The optimized policy increases total annual costs by $260.18 due to higher safety stock requirements, but this is necessary to achieve the target service level with the observed demand and lead time variability.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Intermittent demand pattern (non-zero fraction=0.39) with moderate lead time variability (CV=0.53) requires robust safety stock calculation using combined demand and lead time uncertainty.
research_insights.boundary_risk: High intermittency (non-zero fraction < 0.4) may require specialized forecasting methods like bootstrapping for more accurate safety stock estimation.
